description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractComposite' used as a base for composite validation rules within the OrangeHRM project. It facilitates combining multiple rules into a single composite rule and provides a validate method that applies these rules to an input.

classes.name: AbstractComposite
classes.description: An abstract class that allows combining multiple rules for composite validation logic. It extends AbstractRule and implements a validate method that constructs individual rule instances and applies them to validate input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the composite with a variable number of Rule objects.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Constructs rule instances and delegates validation of input to the composite rule.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the class name of the composite rule.
